title: Rapidly Identifying New Coronavirus Mutations of Potential Concern in the Omicron Variant Using an Unsupervised Learning Strategy
summary: Specific emerging SARS-CoV-2 mutation trajectories are a genomic surveillance finding enabled by unsupervised clustering and temporal analysis. Retain no clinical/functional validation caveat; preprint/journal version is one result.
ai_technology: Primary journal version (same study) reports unsupervised hierarchical clustering/temporal mutation analysis of 4,296 Omicron genomes; identifies core haplotypes and nine emerging mutations with rising trajectories. Mutations are surveillance signals; source states no relevant clinical data for new mutations, and functional effects are speculative.
